authorityClaim: This artifact AUTHORS independently reviewable harness specifications for the five already-named identifiers harness.DR-G01.core-download, harness.DR-G02.core-installed, harness.DR-G03.core-startup, harness.DR-G04.core-memory, and harness.DR-G05.component-delta. Naming already existed (D-086 / D-102). This is the OBL-2 authoring D-160 left open. It does not execute any harness. It does not claim QUALIFIED or DEMONSTRATED. It does not SATISFY DR-101. It does not decide OD-101-1 or OD-101-2. It does not invent D-006 numerals, G05 caps, or machines beyond the adopted D-102 fleet class. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/. v2 removes invented binary-MB constants, closes G03 no-load and G04 RSS observation, and defines G05 paired deltas. It does not invent a D-006 unit successor and does not close OBL-2 on that limb.
purpose: Author G01-G05 harness specifications. v2 lands CLAUDE-CGHS-V1-SF1 and CGHS-V1-SF1/SF2/SF3. It does not close OBL-2 while D-006 MB unit and G02 tree accounting remain UNDECIDED. v3 lands CLAUDE-CGHS-V2-SF1: no-load observation is a dedicated launch, never a G03/G04 timing sample, and does not ptrace or suspend the timed child.

leftoverJoinV3.role: OBL-2 remains leftover-design until these specifications exist and are independently reviewed.

d006.role: Thresholds and 10% regression rule. Numerals stand. Analyze and consented-probe RSS remain outside D-006.

d102.role: Hosted-fleet-class measurement contract governing G03/G04 execution protocol. Exact-machine / exact-OS superseded for G03 and G04 only. This specification does not re-decide that contract.

discipline: SPECIFICATIONS OF EXACT-BYTE INTENT for retained evidence. No harness runs here. Nothing here is executed evidence. QUALIFIED remains condition 4 / DR-012.

threshold.bound: signed compressed distribution-core ≤ 25 MB per platform
threshold.excludes: every language runtime closure (DR-119 / G14 component, not this core)

harnesses.measures: The signed compressed distribution-core closure that v16 names signedDistributionCore: native executable plus its mandatory runtime/data closure. Boundary is packaging, install, update, trust, management/recovery footprint. defaultInstall.excludes stay excluded.
harnesses.exactByteIntent: Per platform: the compressed signed artifact bytes, their sha256, declared size as a raw byte count, the D-006 numeral 25 MB with unit standing UNDECIDED, signature set, SBOM, and the published artifact list. The fixture pins those artifacts. It does not pin 26214400 as an authorized threshold.
harnesses.passProperty: For each of the four platforms, the pinned compressed signed closure is recorded and contains no language-runtime, analyzer, graph-engine, report-generator, evidence-database, or telemetry-backend member of defaultInstall.excludes. Size comparison to 25 MB is scored only after a D-006 unit successor. Exclusion membership is scored now.
failsIf: a language-runtime closure is counted inside the core
the published artifact list and the hashed bytes disagree
signatures or SBOM required by the inventory are absent
this specification is read as authorizing 26214400 as the D-006 bound
harnesses.doesNotClaim: QUALIFIED. Does not execute. Does not decide OD-101-1 or OD-101-2.

threshold.bound: immutable installed tree ≤ 80 MB; mandatory-closure inventory enumerated
threshold.qualitativeHalf: zero undeclared dependencies is DR-126 / G22 (v16 ID-DEP-K2). This specification records inventory completeness structure and does not decide L-TCB identity.

harnesses.measures: The immutable installed tree of the default install. v16 inventorySchema.everyReleaseMustPublish members that this gate owns: complete mandatory file/dependency/TCB inventory and layer assignment; exact installed closure size.
harnesses.exactByteIntent: Per platform: a digest-pinned inventory graph matching v16 inventorySchema.graphRules, the installed-tree raw byte count with accounting method named but not invented here, and a layer assignment for every node. The fixture pins the inventory bytes. It does not pin 83886080 as an authorized threshold.
harnesses.passProperty: For each of the four platforms, every published file node is in the inventory, layer-set cardinality obeys v16 graphRules, and the shared executable if present is exactly one {L-DIST, L-HOST} node. Size comparison to 80 MB is scored only after a D-006 unit-and-accounting successor.
failsIf: a published file is absent from the inventory
duplicate path or duplicate sha256 under a different path
an exclusive-layer violation (L-EVAL or L-COMP co-occurring with another layer, other than the lawful {L-DIST, L-HOST} shared executable)
this specification is read as deciding L-TCB identity
this specification is read as authorizing 83886080 as the D-006 bound
harnesses.doesNotClaim: QUALIFIED. Does not execute. Does not populate the per-OS TCB table. Does not retarget DR-126.

harnesses.claimVerbatim: `--help`/`--version` remain fast and load no components/project

threshold.source: D-006 clause 3 plus D-102 fleet class

harnesses.fleetClass: Adopted D-102 hosted-fleet-class measurement contract. Labels: macos-15 (arm64, 3-core, 7 GB), macos-15-intel (native Intel VM, UDID 4203018E-580F-C1B5-9525-B745CECA79EB), ubuntu-24.04 (x64, 4 CPU, 16 GB), ubuntu-24.04-arm (arm64, 4 CPU, 16 GB). Never Rosetta. macos-26-intel is not this class. Private 2 CPU / 8 GB is not this class.
harnesses.protocol: D-102 turn-2 subject 7780190e… governs N=21, nearest-rank estimator (p50=11, p95=20, p99=21), thin-only projection, preflight, path/digest identity, Linux and macOS target-process protocols, and the paired 10% formula from the second qualified release. This specification does not amend that protocol.
harnesses.exactByteIntent: Per platform and command: 21 accepted TIMING job records (runs-on, P, D0, I0, cold and warm latencies, preflight fields) PLUS one dedicated no-load observation record per command carrying the two fixture digests and the retained event stream. The observation launch is not one of the 21 timing samples. The fixture pins those records and the five operative rank values.
harnesses.passProperty: For each platform and each of --help and --version: cold p50/p95/p99 and warm p95/p99 meet D-006 bounds (already in ms); every accepted job used the D-102 class label; noLoadProtocol.passRule holds; thin-only preflight passed; never Rosetta.
failsIf: any operative percentile exceeds its D-006 bound
N < 21 accepted jobs for a governed series
a fat/universal image is used as the measurement projection
Rosetta-on-Apple-Silicon is used for macos-x86_64
a load event against either hostile fixture tree
observation mechanism is absent (vacuous pass)
this specification invents a machine identifier outside D-102
the no-load observation is taken on a timing sample
the timed child is ptraced or suspended
this specification is read as amending D-102 preflight
harnesses.doesNotClaim: QUALIFIED. Does not execute. Warm p50 is telemetry and must not fail qualification (D-102).

nonVacuousFixtures.FC-G03-COMPONENT-PRESENT: A digest-pinned dummy component payload exists in the component store the product would consult. Its path and sha256 are recorded before launch.
nonVacuousFixtures.FC-G03-PROJECT-PRESENT: A digest-pinned project tree exists on disk. Its root path and a merkle of its files are recorded before launch.

initialState.cwd: A dedicated empty workdir that is neither the project root nor the component store.
initialState.env: No project-root or component-store variable points at those fixtures. PATH does not resolve the fixture payload as an executable.

noLoadProtocol.eventStream: Dedicated observation launch of the same P+D in the noLoadProtocol initialState with both hostile fixtures present. Linux observation child may use strace -f -e trace=file,process because that child is not a timing sample. macOS observation child uses fs_usage -w scoped to that child, or a sandbox profile that DENIES open/read/exec/mmap of the two fixture trees. The timed G03 child is never ptraced or suspended. Absence of an observation mechanism fails the job.
noLoadProtocol.loadDefinition: A load is any open, read, exec, or mmap of a path inside the fixture component payload tree or the fixture project tree. Presence of those trees on disk, or a name in an inventory index that is not opened, is not a load.
noLoadProtocol.passRule: Zero load events against either fixture tree. Missing observation is a fail, not a pass.
noLoadProtocol.standingVsD102: Dedicated observation launch. Never a G03/G04 timing sample. After the event stream is recorded the observation child is SIGKILLed and reaped, matching D-102 preflight. Timing samples of the same P+D then proceed without ptrace or suspend.

threshold.explicitlyOutside: analyze RSS and doctor-with-consented-probes RSS remain outside D-006

harnesses.matrix: same D-102 fleet class; --help/--version cold/warm RSS plus one doctor read-only launch per sample
harnesses.protocol: D-102 G04 series: 21 samples; every accepted sample must be ≤ the D-006 bound (not only the percentile). doctor read-only is one launch per sample, no warm pair. Path/digest identity and preflight are the D-102 contract.
harnesses.exactByteIntent: Per platform: 21 RSS traces for --help, --version, and doctor read-only, each with the rssProtocol retained raw samples and derived steady/peak. The fixture pins those traces.
harnesses.passProperty: Sampling follows rssProtocol. --help/--version use the same cold/warm pairing as G03. doctor read-only is one launch. analyze and consented-probe RSS are not scored. Bound comparison waits on the D-006 unit successor.
failsIf: analyze or consented-probe RSS is scored as this gate
doctor read-only is given a warm pair as if it were help/version
Rosetta or a non-D-102 class is used
samples are taken of the job VM rather than T
this specification is read as authorizing a binary-MB byte constant
harnesses.doesNotClaim: QUALIFIED. Does not execute. Does not invent analyze RSS bounds.

rssProtocol.scope: The spawned measurement process T only. Not the job VM. Not sibling processes.
rssProtocol.linuxPrimitive: /proc/T/status VmRSS (kB) * 1024 = bytes per sample. Sample every 10 ms from the D-102 exec handshake to T exit. peak = max sample. steady = median of samples at or after 20 ms; if the process exits sooner, median of all samples.
rssProtocol.macosPrimitive: task_info(T, TASK_VM_INFO) resident_size bytes per sample. Same 10 ms window, peak, and steady derivation. APIs are those on MacOSX15.4.sdk. PROC_PIDARCHINFO is not used.
rssProtocol.unit: Raw bytes are retained. Comparison to D-006 40/50/60/100 MB is scored only after the same D-006 unit successor named at d006UnitStanding. Until then every sample is recorded and no invented byte constant is used as a pass/fail bound.
rssProtocol.retained: Every raw sample timestamp and value, plus the derived steady and peak, per accepted job.

harnesses.claimVerbatim: Each component cost is independently visible

threshold.bound: measurement and visibility mandatory; NO numeric cap in D-006
threshold.trigger: slice-1 TypeScript provider is a component; the trigger fires in this slice's qualification cycle

harnesses.matrix: D-002 platform × component (slice-1: the TypeScript provider)
harnesses.measures: download, install, start, and RSS delta of that component against the core measured at G01-G04.
harnesses.exactByteIntent: Per platform: the four published deltas bound to pairedWorkload inputs, plus the 21-pair raw start and RSS observations and the exact download/install bytes. The fixture pins those records. Absence of a published delta is a fail. Exceeding a numeric cap is not a fail because no cap exists here.
harnesses.passProperty: Every slice-1 component has published download/install/start/RSS deltas on all four platforms, computed by pairedWorkload.deltaFormula. Caps are not applied.
failsIf: any of the four deltas is unpublished for a slice-1 component on a slice-1 platform
start or RSS uses analyze or a consented probe as the workload
start or RSS uses G03/G04 help/version/doctor-read-only as the subtracted baseline
a start or RSS delta is negative
this specification is read as inventing a numeric cap
harnesses.doesNotClaim: QUALIFIED. Does not execute. Does not invent caps. Caps become product decisions at the first component-acceptance decision.

pairedWorkload.coreOnly: The same thin measurement projection P as G03/G04, with no component admitted.
pairedWorkload.componentEnabled: The same P plus the slice-1 TypeScript provider admitted.
pairedWorkload.command: A host status/inventory command that must enumerate admitted components. Not analyze. Not a consented doctor probe.
pairedWorkload.startEndpoints: From the D-102 exec handshake of that command to the first complete machine-readable inventory record (the last required field of that record is written). Same endpoints on both sides of the pair.
pairedWorkload.rssQuantity: Peak RSS of that command using G04 rssProtocol primitives and window. Not G04 help/version/doctor-read-only baselines.
pairedWorkload.n: Start and RSS: N=21 matched pairs on the D-102 fleet class. Download and install: one exact-byte publication per platform, not N=21.

deltaFormula.install: published installed component tree bytes (exact; accounting waits on the same UNDECIDED G02 domain)
deltaFormula.rss: median_21(componentEnabled peak RSS) - median_21(coreOnly peak RSS)

pairedWorkload.sign: start and RSS deltas must be >= 0. A negative delta means the component cost was hidden in the core and fails.

regressionRule.source: D-006 clause 6 as specialized by D-102 for G03/G04
regressionRule.domain: CORE quantities of G01-G04 only. G05 deltas are visibility-only until a later cap decision.
regressionRule.fromSecondQualifiedRelease: G03 paired 10% on D-102's five operative percentiles; G04 paired 10% on medians of the 21 samples; G01/G02 10% against the previous qualified release's measured compressed and installed sizes. Improvements unbounded.
regressionRule.waiver: product AND release authority, expiry, measured residual; never waives an inherited semantic/trust blocker

d006UnitStanding.numerals: 25 / 80 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 100 MB as written in D-006. Not restated as a byte constant here.
d006UnitStanding.byteMeaning: UNDECIDED. D-006 does not define MB as 1e6 or 2^20. D-102 defines GiB as bytes/1024^3 only for RAM matching, not for these thresholds. This specification does not invent that conversion.
d006UnitStanding.g02InstalledTreeAccounting: UNDECIDED. Logical file lengths vs allocated blocks vs metadata/xattrs vs links vs deduplicated inventory nodes is not decided here.
d006UnitStanding.comparisonRule: A later D-006 unit/accounting successor decides the conversion and G02 domain. Until then a job records raw bytes and the D-006 numeral but cannot claim pass/fail against a byte constant invented here.
